Name: Soft Farmer - Mythic Traits
Author: Crisaius
Description:
This add-on expands [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41768]Soft Farmer[/url] with customizable [b]mythic-inspired features[/b] for the playable farmer, including ears, horns, eye features, and color variations while preserving a slightly cuter aesthetic.

[img]https://imgur.com/jm9chje.png[/img]

• [color=#e69138][size=4]🇬🇧[/size][/color] English (Default)
• [color=#e69138][size=4]🇪🇸[/size][/color] Spanish (Español)
• [color=#e69138][size=4]🇨🇳[/size][/color] Chinese (中文) - Translation by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/yuquansun]yuquansun[/url]

Language is selected automatically based on the game language.

[img]https://imgur.com/P4gmhQX.png[/img]

• [b]Customizable mythic-inspired[/b] ears, horns, eye features, and color variations for the playable farmer.
• Includes Elven, Winged, and Finned Ears, along with Oni, Demon, Unicorn, and Crowned Horns.
• Supports customizable Feather, Fin, Horn, and Sclera color options.
• [b]Mix and match all available traits and colors[/b] to create unique mythic-inspired characters.
• Designed to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41768]Soft Farmer[/url] proportions, hairstyles, and animations.
• Compatible with hats and accessories while preserving ear and horn visibility whenever possible.
• Fully configurable via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][i]Generic Mod Config Menu[/i][/url].

[img]https://imgur.com/zeLF08G.png[/img]

[color=#e69138][b]1[/b][/color]. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[color=#e69138][b]2[/b][/color]. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[color=#e69138][b]3[/b][/color]. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41768]Soft Farmer[/url]﻿.
[color=#e69138][b]4[/b][/color]. Download [b]Soft Farmer - Mythic Traits[/b].
[color=#e69138][b]5[/b][/color]. Extract this mod into your [b]Stardew Valley\Mods[/b] folder.
[quote][b]⚠️[/b] This add-on must be installed as a separate folder inside the Mods directory. Do not place it inside the Soft Farmer folder.[/quote][color=#e69138][b]6[/b][/color]. Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://imgur.com/kQkaEbs.png[/img]

This add-on is fully configurable via [b]Content Patcher[/b] and allows you to customize mythic visual traits for your farmer.

Configuration can be edited via [b]config.json[/b] or with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (if installed).
[line]
[b][color=#e69138]General[/color][/b]
[i]General settings for Mythic Traits.[/i]

　• [b]Enable Mythic Traits[/b][b]:[/b] Enables or disables all Mythic Traits visual changes.
　• [b]Use Custom Hats: [/b]Enables Soft Farmer custom hats instead of vanilla hats.

[img]https://imgur.com/2pHBxqL.png[/img]

📱 [b]Mobile (Android / iOS)[/b]
This add-on may work on mobile, but mobile compatibility is not officially supported. Some features or configurations may behave differently.

⚠️ [b]May cause visual inconsistencies with Fashion Sense[/b]
Both mods can be installed together without crashing, but Mythic Traits is designed around Soft Farmer's default farmer sprites and hairstyles. Some ears, horns, or eye features may not display correctly when using Fashion Sense hairstyles or accessories.

❌ [b]Not compatible with mods that replace the farmer base  or hairstyles[/b]
Mythic Traits relies on Soft Farmer sprite structures and custom head edits. Mods that replace the same farmer assets may cause visual conflicts or prevent certain features from displaying correctly.

[img]https://imgur.com/g03zHCI.png[/img]

Created by Crisaius as an expansion for [b]Soft Farmer[/b].

Special thanks to [b]Poltergeister[/b], creator of [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Cute Characters[/url][/i] and related projects, whose work inspired the original Soft Farmer aesthetic.

Thanks to yuquansun for providing the Chinese translation.

All referenced inspirations are credited in detail on the Soft Farmer mod page.
This mod is non-commercial.
